organs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the organ map to EDIT, its exact exterior silhouette, orientation and framing are LOCKED. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY: use its cheerful clean rounded geometric tile/board-game language. Make Image 1 a CUTE GEOMETRIC ANIME CELL-BATTLE MAP, with matte pastel peach/coral/ivory game terrain, simple softly beveled toy-like obstacles, clean two/three-tone shading and broad connected flat combat floors. Friendly miniature game board, no clinical anatomical rendering. 65-75% of usable floor remains open and connected, with wide gaps around a few purposeful obstacle islands. Replace all thin generic C/D arc markings with a small D-shaped arrangement of organ-themed SOLID rounded geometric blocks; the arc should be communicated by the grouping of separate blocks, never by a plain drawn C. REMOVE all superficial red/blue/violet vessels, their detached segments and sweeping pipe lines. Use CLOSED solid shapes and restrained clean facets. Absolutely no worms, tentacles, twisting tubes, spaghetti, slime, teeth, fingers/tongues, densely perforated pores, hollow donut clusters, realistic wet tissue or glossy inflated organs. No faces, eyes, labels, text, icons, UI or characters. Transparent background. Same exact silhouette and organ framing as image 1. Preserve the original cream bronchial tree and lobe boundaries. Express alveoli as 4-6 small CLOSED pastel rounded hexagonal air-sac tiles, like soft solid cushions, arranged in crescent/D clusters where the old C marks were, plus 2-3 small clusters along peripheral lobes. Each alveolar tile has a tiny shallow colored inset facet rather than a hole. No hollow bubble/donut rings. Calm smooth floor between clusters.
